text:
olga: heads-up: APAC warmpool (ap-south-1) showing ~18 nodes stuck in joining after last night's egress harden. allocator logs show `keystore: rpc error: code = Unavailable desc = connection refused`
sam: confirmed, internal-keystore is in 10.180.6.0/24 which is now denied by the new outbound baseline. nodes need that for disk unwrap on boot.
wei: impact: onboarding stalled -> reserved GPUs idling. cost spike estimate?
cost-ops: rough calc: idle GPU minutes doubled; current burn ~ $2.7k/hr if unresolved.
olga: can we fast-fix without violating compliance?
security: we can approve a timeboxed, scoped egress allow to the keystore IPs, limited to warmpool SG and port 443. Need a PR and audit justification. TTL preferred 30m.
sam: creating PR infra/hotfix/apac-allow-keystore. snippet:
```hcl
resource "aws_security_group_rule" "tmp_allow_keystore_apac" {
  type              = "egress"
  from_port         = 443
  to_port           = 443
  protocol          = "tcp"
  cidr_blocks       = ["10.180.6.11/32"]
  description       = "TEMP allow: warmpool -> keystore for disk unwrap (30m)"
  security_group_id = aws_security_group.gpu_warmup.id
}
```
ops-bot: alert: gpu-warmup-onboard-fail_ap-south-1 (count=18) severity=high
deploy-bot: apply started infra/hotfix/apac-allow-keystore at 6205004388 by sam
wei: canary 3 nodes warmed after applying. setting ALLOC_LOG_LEVEL=debug for canary to capture handshake details.
ops-bot: canary: 3/3 warmed at 6205004420
sam: rolling to 15 -> full warm pool. watching metrics and billing.
security: approved temporary rule (sam/olga/wei). Audit note: emergency keystore access restore to prevent large billing impact during onboarding. TTL 30m. Must document exception in change-control.
cost-ops: observed idle minutes dropping; projected burn back to baseline in ~10m.
wei: prod rollout complete, warm pool stabilizing. scheduling follow-up: infra#5120 to route keystore traffic via control-plane egress-gw and sync approved lists with security.
sam: removing temp rule now, will attach post-deploy notes to PR.
deploy-bot: destroy infra/hotfix/apac-allow-keystore completed at 6205004506 by sam
ops-bot: post-check: warm-pool healthy, 0 onboarding failures at 6205004509
olga: postmortem summary: root cause = overly-broad egress deny that included internal keystore subnet. mitigation = timeboxed scoped allow. action items: 1) infra#5120 implement keystore egress-gateway 2) security to publish exception runbook + SLA for emergency egresst 3) add e2e onboarding test that validates keystore path.
security: will pick up exception runbook. Please include PR link + PM signoff in infra#5120.
wei: closing alert. thanks all :thumbsup:
